derived_from: backend/internal/httpd/apispec/openapi.yaml (generated code-first from Go; the authoritative REST envelope shapes)
backend/internal/domain/activity.go (ActivityState vocabulary and the waiting_input vs blocked distinction)
backend/internal/ports/agent.go (NormalizePermissionMode: empty AND unknown collapse to default)
backend/internal/session_manager/manager.go (effectiveAgentConfig role overlay; verbatim caller branch on spawn)
backend/internal/httpd/events.go (SSE frame format: id/event/data, after + Last-Event-ID)
backend/internal/terminal/protocol.go (/mux channels, frame types, base64 PTY payloads)
backend/internal/httpd/router.go (healthz/readyz payload: status/service/pid, no boot id)

sanitization.identifiers: Every project id, session id, terminal handle and branch is synthetic. AgentRunIds are pinned canonical UUIDv7 values so fixtures stay static data rather than templates a test has to interpolate.
sanitization.paths: The only path present is the synthetic project path /w/ao-project. No developer home directory, no real worktree and no machine path appears.
sanitization.prompts: No real prompt, message or transcript text. Bodies are short synthetic strings.
sanitization.credentials: No credential material of any kind: no tokens, no cookies, no request headers and no account identifiers. AO's /api/v1/agents list is recorded as harness ids and labels only, which is all AO exposes there.

recorded_facts.healthz_has_no_boot_id: GET /healthz and /readyz return status/service/pid/executablePath/cwd. There is no boot or instance identifier, so a new adapter generation can never be minted from a liveness probe alone. Generation continuity is decided by the persisted global change_log cursor instead.
recorded_facts.sse_sequence_is_global: change_log seq is global across the daemon, not per session. Continuity must be validated over every event before filtering by session, or another session's event reads as this session's gap.
recorded_facts.session_view_has_no_workspace_path: ControllersSessionView exposes id/projectId/kind/harness/branch/activity/status/isTerminated/terminalHandleId and timestamps. AO's internal workspacePath is not in the public envelope, which is why PrepareWorkspace is unsupported.
recorded_facts.send_max_length: SendSessionMessageRequest.message is maxLength 4096, which is the adapter's declared max_message_bytes.
recorded_facts.display_name_max_length: SpawnSessionRequest.displayName is maxLength 20. A Kontor correlation label is longer, so the label rides `branch` and never the display name.
recorded_facts.no_parent_field: 0.12.1 exposes no durable parent/child session link. AO-internal orchestrator children appear flat in the inventory, so a parent is never inferred from a name, a timestamp or branch proximity.
recorded_facts.codex_residual_hook_trust_bypass: AO always appends --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust to Codex argv (appendHookTrustBypassFlag) so its activity hooks run without an interactive trust review. This is unconditional and is NOT removed by choosing accept-edits or auto. It is recorded here as a residual trust fact and is deliberately not used to claim a higher trust grade.
